{{Quote|This is not going well at all.|Nute Gunray watches a battle unfold via ARENA-7580|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
'''ARENA-7580''' was a state-of-the-art [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] developed by [[Imlok]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Description==
With the combined input of on-site cameras and tracking sensors, this platform-mounted tactical monitoring system displayed a detailed, three-dimensional view of the battlefield. It was capable of identifying minute details amidst the chaos of war, such as individual troop movement.

==History==
The [[Geonosian War Room/Legends|Geonosian War Chamber]] located within [[Stalgasin hive/Legends|Stalgasin hive]] was outfitted with this device during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. Even with the added benefits of the ARENA-7580, [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|CIS forces]] were sent into retreat by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]].
